research.notes: The agenda names the Oakland R&D campus; the legal entity found is the network nonprofit, Leadership Public Schools Inc, which operates that campus. The profile describes the network. The California Secretary of State and SAM.gov records were not checked.

profile.summary: Leadership Public Schools is a network of public charter high schools in the Bay Area, with campuses in Hayward, Oakland (Oakland R&D) and Richmond. It is run by a nonprofit education organization based in Oakland, California.

sources.title: Leadership Public Schools Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: leadps.org lists LPS Oakland R&D as one of three network high schools and shows the Oakland address, phone and general email; ProPublica shows Leadership Public Schools Inc (EIN 73-1643646) as an Oakland 501(c)(3) in NTEE B29, which fits a Measures N and H MOU for an Oakland high school campus. The summary is neutral and supported, though the Secretary of State and SAM.gov records were not checked.
